name: Rap Simulator

LATEST UPDATE:
- Treasures are now scattered throughout the map! 💰
- Select a producer to follow you around, then click/tap on treasure to attack it (pet simulator style) 🐶
- Collecting treasure will give you a new currency called gems 💎 
- You can spend these gems in the new swords shops that have opened up in each map ⚔️ 
- Use these swords to deal more damage to treasures 💥
- Swords also give you a 

✨Reach 100,000 streams and get a FREE ADDITIONAL PLAQUE SLOT in YouTube Simulator X! Reach 1,000,000 streams and get another one!

🎤Welcome to Rap Simulator, brought to you by Indieun. Go from a broke noob to a rich and famous rapper! Grow your fan base and give tours around the world! Will you be the next biggest thing in hip-hop?

🎤Console users use DPAD to SCROLL DOWN on SCROLLING FRAMES!

🎤Premium users get access to EXCLUSIVE materials to paint their car with!

🎤Maps by o_vvolf, follow him on twitter @vvolfyyy
